unit.why: A single continuous narrative about the Besht in Brody: the meat he declares carrion at a circumcision feast, his clash with R. Hayyim Sanzer and R. Moshe Ostrer, and his vindication through R. David Purkes.

stories.start_quote: מעשה נוראה מרבינו הבעש״ט הקדוש זי"ע
stories.summary_en: The Besht promises a childless rabbi in Brody a son and comes to be sandak, but at the feast he declares the meat carrion, angering the anti-Hasidic geonim of Brody. His disciple R. David Purkes later defends him in a sermon, and the shochet is discovered committing adultery with his daughter-in-law and confesses that he deliberately damaged his knife to test the Besht.

quotes: שישלח להשוחט אשר יראה הסכין של שחוטה
אשר הוא עובר עבירה עם כלתו

quotes: ויבחנו אותו ויראו כי הוא טוב מאוד וכשר לשחוט

tags.why: Inspection of the slaughter knife drives the plot.
